Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against target CHEMBL3880. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3880' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return columns molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
